data.description:
## Context / Problem
fervent-cultish-sanderling added `scripts/check_verify_host.py` (the `verify-host` prerequisite of `make verify`), a ci_gate mechanism whose mechanism-ok marker names this ticket as its sunset. It exists because agent sandboxes deny AF_UNIX sockets and outbound HTTPS that the suite needs.

## Approach
Remove the script, its test, the Makefile target and the docs section once either (a) the suite no longer needs those capabilities (the reclaim re-sign tests no longer use a socket ssh-agent, build-provenance tests build without isolation from the index, and the opengrep backend validates offline), or (b) every supported local agent harness grants them to `make verify`.

## Scope
- `scripts/check_verify_host.py`, `tests/unit/test_check_verify_host.py`, `Makefile`, `docs/local-dev-env.md`, `AGENTS.md`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The preflight and its docs are removed, with the condition (a) or (b) that made it unnecessary recorded here.
data.title: Retire the make verify host preflight when no supported local host can lack AF_UNIX sockets or outbound HTTPS
